packageRules.description: Group Kotlin, KSP, and Compilers. Exclude kotlinx to avoid unneeded version locks.
Group Compose UI and Foundation libraries.
Provide direct links to Gradle release notes in PRs.

Remotion ships a release almost every day, and promo/remotion is a non-shipping asset-rendering project. Pull it out of the all-minor-patch group and refresh it once a week so it collapses into a single Monday PR instead of several per week.

Keep aboutlibraries and Coil out of the gradle minor/patch automerge so they land as reviewable PRs. The known aboutlibraries shrinkResources failure is a runtime R8 issue on the licenses screen, which CI's assembleDebug-only build job cannot catch, and Coil minors move image loading across the whole feed. This is a review gate, not a version pin — both are free to reach their latest release.
